# identity

Users, groups, roles, permissions (opt-in).

- Toolset name: `identity`
- Enabled by default: no (opt-in with `--toolsets default,identity`)
- Tools: 23 (10 read-only)

## Tools

### `openvas_create_group`

**Create group** · mutating

Create a user group. Not idempotent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `name` | string | yes | Name |
| `users` | array<string> | no | Member login names |

### `openvas_create_permission`

**Create permission** · mutating

Grant a permission (a GMP command, optionally scoped to one resource) to a user, group or role. Not idempotent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `name` | string | yes | Permission name (a GMP command name, e.g. "get_targets") |
| `resource_id` | string | no | UUID of the grant target resource |
| `resource_type` | string | no | Backend resource type of the grant target (e.g. "task") |
| `subject_id` | string | no | UUID of the subject |
| `subject_type` | string | no | Who receives the grant: user, group or role |

### `openvas_create_role`

**Create role** · mutating

Create a role. Not idempotent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `name` | string | yes | Name |
| `users` | array<string> | no | Member login names |

### `openvas_create_user`

**Create user** · mutating

Create a gvmd user account. Not idempotent.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `authentication_type` | string | no | Authentication backend: file, ldap_connect or radius_connect |
| `comment` | string | no | Optional comment |
| `hosts` | string | no | Host restriction expression as stored by gvmd |
| `name` | string | yes | Login name |
| `password` | string | no | Initial password (required for `file` authentication) |
| `roles` | array<string> | no | Role UUIDs to assign |

### `openvas_delete_group`

**Delete group** · destructive

Delete a user group (to the trashcan by default; `ultimate` deletes permanently).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Resource UUID |
| `ultimate` | boolean | no | Permanently delete instead of moving to the trashcan (default false) |

### `openvas_update_user`

**Update user** · destructive

Update a user account (password, roles, host restriction). Idempotent (PUT): omitted fields stay unchanged.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `authentication_type` | string | no |  |
| `comment` | string | no |  |
| `hosts` | string | no |  |
| `id` | string | yes | UUID of the user to update |
| `name` | string | no | New login name |
| `password` | string | no | New password |
| `roles` | array<string> | no | Replacement role UUIDs (omitting leaves roles unchanged) |
